Process

How IDENTRA Works

A simple four-step process connects your palm to secure digital payments.

01

Choose Portal

Select Customer or Merchant from the top of the home page.

02

Login

Your selected account type opens its own separate login page.

03

Verify

Customer protected payments use palm authentication and security checks.

04

Pay / Collect

Customers send payments and merchants receive them in their dedicated portals.

Security First.
